_readme: Pre-written announcements for /announce template:<name>. The text opens in a form so you can edit it before posting. Placeholders: {legion} {ea} {ea_relative} {launch} {launch_relative} {registration} {roles} {guides} {events}

recruitment.title: ⚜️ {legion} is recruiting for AION2
recruitment.body:
AION2 Early Access opens **{ea}** ({ea_relative}), and the global launch follows on **{launch}**.

{legion} is building its AION2 roster **now**, so we're organized on day one.

**How to join**
1️⃣ Read the guides in {guides}. Start with **Kanon's AION 2 Bible**.
2️⃣ Apply in {registration}. It takes 2 minutes.
3️⃣ When you're accepted, pick your class and ping roles in {roles}.

**What we're looking for**
• Active players for Early Access or launch week
• All 8 classes welcome (edit this line if you need specific classes)
• People who show up for legion content and read the guides

Applications are reviewed daily by officers. See you in Atreia. ⚜️

early-access.title: ⏳ AION2 Early Access: {ea_relative}
early-access.body:
Early Access (Founder's Pack) opens **{ea}**.
Global free-to-play launch: **{launch}**.

**Before you log in**
• Finish the download early. Don't wait for server-open.
• Read **Kanon's AION 2 Bible** in {guides}.
• Lock in your class and set your role in {roles}.
• Not in the legion yet? Apply in {registration} **today**.

The legion meet-up time will be posted in {events} once NC confirms server-open time.
